# IPTVNetworkHub

> IPTVNetworkHub is an IPTV streaming service offering live TV, live sports, news, movies and series in a single subscription, with setup guides for Smart TV, Android TV, Amazon Fire TV Stick, Android, iPhone/iPad, Windows and Mac. Plans start at €15 and every plan includes a one-day free trial.

Key facts for agents:

- Pricing: €15 / 1 month, €30 / 3 months, €49 / 12 months. All plans include 19,000+ live channels, 35,000+ movies and series, HD/Full HD/4K where available, and TV guide (EPG).
- Free trial: new subscribers get a one-day free trial on any plan.
- Contract: no long-term contracts; subscriptions can be cancelled.
- Hardware: no satellite dish or cable box is required — IPTV is delivered over an internet connection.
- Support and orders are handled over WhatsApp at +44 7938 593704 (https://wa.me/447938593704).
- Content and pricing details on this site are informational; orders are confirmed through WhatsApp support.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/): Overview of the service, pricing plans, supported devices, popular guides and FAQs.
- [Live TV channels](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/channels.html): Channel guide covering live sports, news, movies, kids, documentary and entertainment channels.
- [Sports & football](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/sports.html): Live sports coverage — football, basketball, cricket, motorsport and more.
- [Movies & Series](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/movies-series.html): On-demand movies and TV series, including action, thriller, drama, animation and family titles.
- [Contact](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/contact.html): How to reach support to start a free trial or get setup help.
- [About](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/about.html): What IPTVNetworkHub is and what the service provides.
- [IPTV Guides](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/iptv-guides.html): Index of all setup and how-to guides.

## Setup guides

- [What is IPTV and how does it work?](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/what-is-iptv.html): Beginner introduction to IPTV, live TV streaming, playlists and compatible devices.
- [IPTV on Smart TV](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/iptv-on-smart-tv.html): General Smart TV setup guide.
- [IPTV on Samsung Smart TV](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/iptv-on-samsung-smart-tv.html): Setup steps specific to Samsung Smart TV devices.
- [IPTV on LG Smart TV](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/iptv-on-lg-smart-tv.html): Setup steps specific to LG Smart TV devices.
- [IPTV on Android](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/iptv-on-android.html): Using IPTV on Android phones and tablets.
- [IPTV on Android TV](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/iptv-on-android-tv.html): Setup for Android TV boxes and Android TV devices.
- [IPTV on Firestick](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/iptv-on-firestick.html): Setting up IPTV on an Amazon Fire TV Stick.
- [Login details guide](https://iptvnetworkhub.com/iptv-login-details.html): How to use the access details supplied after ordering.
